component.name: Audium
component.summary: Listen to your audiobook library, offline

description.p: Audium is a desktop audiobook player for the books you already have on disk. It works entirely offline: no accounts, no cloud, no online lookups, no telemetry.
It only reads your library. Audium never changes, moves, renames or deletes your audio files; everything it learns or you edit is kept in its own database.

ul.li: Imports large, messy libraries: single m4b files, folders of parts, CD1/CD2 subfolders and loose files
Remembers where you are in every book, with per-book speed
Chapters, bookmarks with notes, and a sleep timer that fades out
Search, authors, series, collections and a bookshelf view
Listening statistics, and export/import of your progress
Media keys, the Plasma media controls and a tray icon

description.p: Packages for Fedora, openSUSE Tumbleweed, Debian and Ubuntu, and a Flatpak file.

ul.li: Fixed: Audium could stop starting after the system updated Qt, until it was rebuilt
Fixed: Audium didn't start with Qt 6.8 (Debian 13)
Fixed: right after a book ended, the next book could start from the beginning instead of where you left off
Progress bars under covers now show with every widget style, not only Breeze
The scroll bar of the Home rows no longer covers book titles and authors
